transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I don’t enjoy anything I used to love—church socials, baking, even talking with neighbors all feel empty now. It just feels like all the joy has been completely drained out of my life.
Have you felt this way for most of the past two years, or is this a distinct change from how you were feeling a few months ago?

No, it hasn't been two years—this is a distinct change that started after my mother passed away ten months ago. This heavy sadness and loss of interest have been weighing on me steadily for about seven months now, ever since the first holidays and church events came and went without her.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of deep sadness, loss of interest, or low mood in your life before this current episode began seven months ago?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before my mother passed away. This is the first time in my life I've ever felt this kind of deep sadness and emptiness.
Besides the loss of interest, have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels over these past seven months?

Food has lost all its taste to me, so I've been skipping meals and my clothes are hanging much looser now. I also feel completely exhausted no matter how much time I spend in bed, and even just taking a shower feels like I've run a marathon. I just have no energy left for anything.
Have you noticed if you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or conversely, do you feel so restless that you find it difficult to sit still?

I don't feel restless at all; instead, it feels like I am moving through molasses. Simple things like getting from bed to the bathroom, shuffling to the mailbox, or even answering questions take me forever now. People at church have even asked if I'm sick because I move and talk so slowly.
Beyond the slowness you've described, have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness or excessive, inappropriate guilt during these past seven months?

Yes, I feel terrible guilt because I've become convinced that my mother's death was a punishment meant for me. I feel like such a heavy burden to everyone around me now, and I honestly feel like they would all be better off if I just disappeared.
